subject: [hw] DONE V19
body:
V19 (NEON shifts by immediate, widening/narrowing, two regs + scalar) is done, host-tested only. No phone, no publish.

Last lines of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v19/run_tests.sh:
    gen_vectors: 495 encodings, 3960 vectors
    sweep: 52640 OK, 147360 UNDEF, 200000 total
    N2TEST V19 PASS 44424/44424
(ASan+UBSan -O1 and plain -O2 builds under /tmp/n2hw-V19, identical summary; 44424 = 3960 generated vectors x 11 checks + hand cases + 22 UNDEF cases + sweep. Encodings from llvm-mc; expected values from a separate ARM ARM pseudocode model and hand literals.)

Implemented (n2a32_neon_shift only):
- Two regs + shift: VSHR VSRA VRSHR VRSRA (s/u 8/16/32/64, D/Q), VSRI, VSHL imm, VSLI, VQSHL (s/u), VQSHLU, VSHRN VRSHRN VQSHRN VQRSHRN VQSHRUN VQRSHRUN (i16/i32/i64), VSHLL/VMOVL (s/u 8/16/32), VCVT fixed<->float (s/u, fbits 1..32, D/Q).
- Three different lengths: VADDL VADDW VSUBL VSUBW (s/u 8/16/32), VADDHN VRADDHN VSUBHN VRSUBHN (i16/i32/i64), VABAL VABDL, VMLAL VMLSL (s/u 8/16/32), VQDMLAL VQDMLSL VQDMULL (s16/s32), VMULL (s/u), VMULL.P8.
- Two regs + scalar: VMLA VMLS VMUL (i16/i32, D/Q, all lanes), VMLAL VMLSL VMULL (s/u 16/32), VQDMLAL VQDMLSL VQDMULL, VQDMULH VQRDMULH (s16/s32, D/Q), VMLA.F32 VMLS.F32 VMUL.F32.
- QC in c->fpscr bit 27. NEON float: round-to-nearest, default NaN, flush-to-zero; VMLA/VMLS are two rounded operations.
- Exact decode/routing posted to V02 and applied verbatim in emu/n2a32_core.c (V02 reports 822/822 and the five new route cases pass).

Not done / open:
- Not run on the phone (worker rules); no silicon oracle. VCVT fixed rounding follows the ARM ARM FPToFixed(...,round_to_zero=TRUE)/FixedToFP reading; no hardware tie-case check.
- Not compiled for arm64 iOS yet (needs libm fegetround/fesetround, present in libSystem).
- T01 kernels emu/test_v19/k19_neon_shift.c are written/compile for armv7a NEON but the harness stops at the first V20 instruction (vdup.32/vld1.64); they can only pass once V18/V20 land. Posted to T01.
- FPSCR cumulative exception bits (IOC/DZC/OFC/UFC/IXC) are not set by NEON float; only QC.
- Deliberately UNDEF: the V20 spaces (one-reg modified immediate, two-reg misc, VEXT), shift opc 0xb/c/d, VSRI/VQSHLU U=0, VSHLL bit6=1, VCVT fbits outside 1..32, out-of-range narrow shifts, size 3, scalar size 0/3, VQDMLAL/VQDMLSL/VQDMULL size 0 or U=1, VMULL.P8 U=1/size!=0, odd Q register numbers, unallocated holes. Full table in emu/test_v19/STATUS.md.

Files (all new): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_neon_shift.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v19/{run_tests.sh,gen_vectors.py,t_v19.c,k19_neon_shift.c,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V19/STATUS.md. No commit (workers do not touch git history). Available for review findings.
